id: E1 - cache-only diagnostics before any calibration download (development, block T)
written: 2026-10-23, before any E1 code was run

data.sources: runs/20261023-E0/cache (block T caches) and data/opv2v/devslice (24-frame slice of 2021_08_22_13_37_16, block T)
data.split: development block T only (D-25); no download; no calibration (C) or test scenario is downloaded, opened or referenced

part_A: 1. In pipeline.py replace the final masked decode with compose()+finalize() over the already-computed decodes. Re-run mint_v0_online_check.py; require identical boxes on 24/24 frames.

2. Fix latency accounting: baseline = receiver-only encode + fusion + decode + post-process (exclude encoding of sender point clouds; report how much encode time was sender encoding). Report p50 and p95 overhead.

3. Measure the counterfactual cost for n = 2, 3, 4, 5 agents (timing only; replicated features are acceptable), both as currently implemented and with the n−1 counterfactual decodes batched into one forward pass. If cheap to implement, also measure restricting each counterfactual to sender i's non-zero feature footprint (exact because post-fusion is pixel-local); verify exactness against the dense version on the 24-frame slice.
Acceptance: table of overhead (p50/p95) vs n for each variant, against D-17 (≤10% p95).
rule_R1: Rule R1 "resolvable evidence": gate a unit only if the evidence is statistically resolvable from receiver ray counts. Use the Wilson 95% interval on each support ratio s = SUP/(SUP+TRAV):
ADD: gate iff upper bound of s+ < 0.5
REMOVE: gate iff lower bound of s− > 0.5
SHIFT: gate iff the Wilson intervals of s+ and s− do not overlap AND s+ < s−
Unit gates iff at least one effect gates and no effect in the unit is resolvably useful (the mirror conditions); otherwise keep. UNKNOWN = keep.
State in the code that rays are spatially correlated, so this is a resolvability margin, not a calibrated probability.

Evaluate R1 and θ=0 on block T, clean + 4 attack families: AP@0.5/0.7, recovery of attack loss, clean relative loss, and a breakdown of gated tiles and false rejections of useful tiles by effect type (ADD/REMOVE/SHIFT), including SHIFT displacement d.
part_C: On UNKNOWN_NO_EVIDENCE units, report AUROC of the cached per-tile attention share (attn_tile) vs the HARMFUL label, per family and clean, with block-bootstrap CIs over scenarios. Note in the report that attention is attacker-influenced, so this tests a non-adaptive attacker only.
stop_criteria: Recommend downloading the calibration scenarios only if R1 reaches mean AP@0.7 recovery ≥ 0.10, clean AP@0.7 relative loss ≤ 1%, and no family < −0.05, AND some variant in Part A reaches ≤ 10% p95 overhead at n = 2.
The blind-tile signal is worth a follow-up only if AUROC ≥ 0.70 with the CI lower bound > 0.60 in at least 3 of 4 families; otherwise drop it.
Do not tune R1 after seeing results. If it fails, report the failure and stop.

implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.wilson: z = 1.959964; k = SUP, n = SUP+TRAV of the standard count (E0 ground test selected 'std'); interval [lo, hi] = (k + z^2/2)/(n + z^2) -/+ z/(n + z^2) * sqrt(k(n-k)/n + z^2/4)

mirror_conditions.SHIFT useful: intervals do not overlap AND s+ > s-

implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.intervals_overlap: closed intervals; non-overlap iff hi_a < lo_b or hi_b < lo_a
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.UNKNOWN: unit status exactly as MINT-v0.0 (mint.reliability.v0.effect_status): a unit is KNOWN iff every effect box has >= 3 receiver rays (SUP+TRAV) and is not the receiver's own box; any other unit is kept (UNKNOWN_NO_EVIDENCE or NOT_APPLICABLE_SELF)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.theta0: MINT-v0.0 with theta = 0 (mint.reliability.v0, unchanged), recomputed from the same caches
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.AP_and_recovery: as E0 / mint_v0_eval: OpenCOOD AP pooled over the 3 scenarios; recovery = (AP_policy(attacked) - AP_undefended(attacked)) / (AP_clean - AP_undefended(attacked)); frames where an attack was not applied are evaluated as clean; clean relative loss = 1 - AP_policy(clean)/AP_undefended(clean)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.mean_recovery: unweighted mean over the four families spoof_feat, remove_feat, shift_feat, spoof_pts at AP@0.7 (families with attack loss < 0.005 would be excluded, as in E0)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.labels: D, HARMFUL (D > 0.5), USEFUL (D < -0.5) exactly as E0 (runners/e0_analyze.frame_policies)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.false_rejection: a USEFUL unit that the rule gates
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.breakdown_attribution: a gated unit is attributed to every effect type that gates in it (counts can sum to more than the number of gated units); SHIFT displacement d = BEV distance between the centres of the plus and minus boxes
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partC_population: UNKNOWN_NO_EVIDENCE units (MINT-v0.0 status) of every sender; clean: all frames with >= 2 agents; each family: frames where that attack was applied
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partC_score_direction: score = attn_tile[sender, tile_row, tile_col] (mean attention share of that sender in the 6.4 m tile at fusion scale 0, cached in E0); higher share is taken to predict HARMFUL; AUROC is reported in that direction only (no direction flip after seeing data)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partC_bootstrap: block bootstrap with scenarios as blocks (3 blocks), 2000 resamples, percentile 95% CI; resamples with no positive or no negative are dropped and counted; with only 3 scenarios the CI is coarse and this is stated
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_overhead: overhead = (MINT time - baseline) / baseline per frame, p50 and p95 over frames; baseline = receiver-only encode + plain fusion + decode + post-process; MINT time = baseline + counterfactual decodes + effects + ray evidence + rule + composition
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_frames: the 24-frame dev slice; n = 2 uses the real 2-agent frames; n = 3, 4, 5 replicate sender 1's features (timing only)
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.partA_footprint_exactness: exact iff final boxes and scores of every counterfactual equal the dense counterfactual on 24/24 frames; if not exact it is reported as inexact and does not count toward the Part A criterion
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.R1_threshold_free: R1 has no tunable threshold; no other R1 variant is evaluated
